items.caption: Oracle-script-style 名 has a small, open, rounded form to the left of a tall curved form with an inner opening. The drawing shows a historical form associated with 名; its shapes alone do not establish the received 夕-and-口 interpretation.
items.alt: Black oracle-script-style drawing with a small open rounded shape on the left and a tall curved shape with an inner opening on the right.
items.selection_reason: This character-specific early-script form helps illustrate the entry’s account of 名 in oracle-bone records. The image is a modern redraw, and its visible shapes do not establish the graph’s original motivation.
items.period: Shang oracle-script style; no narrower date supplied for this particular drawing

items.caption: Bronze-script-style 名 has a broad, curved upper form with an opening and a separate rounded form below. It is a drawing associated with a Western Zhou inscription, not a photograph of the inscribed vessel.
items.alt: Black bronze-script-style drawing with a broad upper shape containing an opening and a rounded shape below.
items.selection_reason: This character-specific form adds a useful visual comparison with the oracle-script-style drawing without implying that the two images establish a sequence of graphic change.
items.period: Western Zhou bronze-script style; cited as B01197 and associated with 南宮乎鐘, 集成00181

limitations.text: These drawings represent historical script forms, but neither is a photograph of an original inscription. The received explanation connects 名 with 夕 and 口 and identifying oneself by speaking at night; the available evidence does not establish that explanation as the graph’s original motivation.
